source_freeze.title: Increasing connectivity between metapopulation ecology and landscape ecology

response_firewall.note: MetadataS1.docx was checksummed but its convenience artifact copy was not used for adjudication because the one-time workflow treated its binary bytes as documentation text. Scientific adjudication relies on the frozen R code, bounded CSV headers, source manifest and public article methods.

response_free_schema_adjudication.node_definition: possible wetland sites, not only sampled or eventually occupied sites
response_free_schema_adjudication.evidence_basis: Frozen source code declares nSites from all coordinate rows, nSampled from the 47-row detection array, three founder sites, NA-aware repeated detection, and explicit destroyed-site states.

allowed_validation_claim: Founder-conditioned, multi-horizon survey-recorded detection/reachability from the three known 2003 reintroduction ponds across the full 274-wetland candidate network.
disallowed_validation_claim: Annual changing-current-source prediction over the full network, because occupancy is observed at only 47 of 274 nodes and latent unsurveyed occupancy may not be imported as observed EOG source state.
next_gate: Parse only coords.dryad.csv and water.dryad.csv, freeze node order/founder IDs, and run the unchanged response-blind 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90 LCC structural-scale gate before any detection row is opened.
no_rescue: Do not switch back to annual current-source prediction, infer unsurveyed sources from published latent occupancy, or restrict the 274-node universe using future detections.
